اقتصرنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرْنَا (iqtaṣarnā) /iq.ta.sˤar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرْنَا (uqtuṣirnā) /uq.tu.sˤir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
